map.平滑短期波动：用简单移动平均（SMA）消除日/周噪声，看清销售趋势走向。: Smooth short-term fluctuation: use a simple moving average (SMA) to remove daily/weekly noise and see the sales trend clearly.

: SMA(3): period 3 = (100+120+110)/3 = 110; period 4 = (120+110+130)/3 = 120; period 5 = (110+130+140)/3 = 126.67.
The next-period forecast = the mean of the latest window = (110+130+140)/3 = 126.67.
WMA(3) with weights 1/2/3 gives period 5 = (110x1+130x2+140x3)/6 = 133.33, more responsive to recent data; the EMA smoothing factor is alpha = 2/(3+1) = 0.5.
map.SMA、WMA、EMA 怎么选？: How to choose between SMA, WMA and EMA?
map.SMA 最平滑但滞后；WMA 给近期更高权重、对拐点更敏感；EMA 用 α 递推: SMA is smoothest but lags; WMA weights recent periods more and reacts faster to turning points; EMA recurs with alpha, needs only the previous result and suits streaming forecasts. Use SMA when data are noisy, and WMA/EMA when the trend is strong and you want to keep up.
map.窗口 N 越大越好吗？: Is a larger window N always better?
map.N 越大越平滑但越滞后、越忽略近期；N 越小越灵敏但易受噪声干扰。一般取 3–6: Larger N gives a smoother but more lagging curve that ignores recent data; smaller N is more responsive but more easily disturbed by noise. Usually take 3-6; with clear seasonality take the cycle length (e.g. 12).
